proposals.title: Never ship a video without description and hashtags
proposals.change: Make the ship step reject manifests with an empty description or fewer than 3 or more than 5 hashtags. Two of the last seven manifests had neither.
proposals.expectedEffect: More discovery signals on every video

proposals.title: Put the product or scheme name first in the title
proposals.change: Titles start with the product (PPF, SIP, FD, ELSS...) or a code-computed headline number within the first 40 characters; keep 40-70 characters. A/B via an experiment flag.
proposals.risk: Less variety in openings; keep the opening-phrase rule

proposals.title: Check custom thumbnail is applied and bottom-fifth is clear
proposals.change: Owner-side: confirm the publisher sets thumbnail.png via thumbnails.set. Agent-side: renderer thumbnail keeps text to 4 words or fewer, none in the bottom 20%.
